info.title: Opes360 API
info.description:
Token-authenticated access to a business's records. A token can never do more than the person it belongs to could do while signed in.

Generated from the router by `php artisan opes:export-openapi` — do not edit by hand.

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: A key you generate. Repeating a request with the same key replays the first response instead of doing the work again.

tags.name: Scopes
tags.description: Token scopes: `read` — Read your business data; `write` — Create and change records; `money` — Record payments and expenses; `people` — Read staff and payroll. A token minted without any holds them all.
